source.source_name: GitHub REST Git database guide: checking pull request mergeability
source.purpose: Prevent stale refs/pull/N/merge candidates from being mistaken for current main integration proof
source.cost_quota: free public official docs; no API credits or secrets
source.reliability_limits: GitHub warns merge refs can go stale; PR GET starts an asynchronous update and immediate ref read may still be stale. A mergeability flag or head-only check is not current integration CI proof.

learning.title: PR test merge refs need current-main parent SHA verification
learning.claim: GitHub pull request test merge refs can become stale without warning. Reading refs/pull/N/merge alone does not prove integration with the current main; explicitly fetch the PR to request a test merge candidate, then compare its first parent SHA with current main and require fresh checks on the candidate before treating it as current integration evidence.
learning.decision: PR_MERGE_REF_CURRENT_BASE_GATE: Before reporting a promotion PR as tested against current main, read main SHA, request PR mergeability via GET /pulls/N, then inspect refs/pull/N/merge commit parents. If first parent differs from current main or there is no fresh relevant CI evidence for the actual candidate, report PARTIAL and do not merge or label integration green. Do not force-update refs or bypass policy.
